Mission.title: Mission
Mission.headline:
One city.
One heart.
Thousands of
small acts.
Mission.p1: From December 1 to 31, we fill the Heart of Kragujevac together, pixel by pixel.
Mission.p2: Each pixel is worth 1,000 dinars, and every purchase becomes a part of one big shared heart.
Mission.p3: Our goal is to fill it by the end of December and raise funds for the Children's Clinic in Kragujevac and the Children's Shelter in Kragujevac.
Mission.p4: One person doesn't have to do a lot. It's enough that many of us do a little.
Mission.cta: Choose your pixel and become part of the Heart of Kragujevac.

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.headline:
A few steps.
One pixel.
One good deed.

step1.title: Pick a pixel
step1.text: Tap any free pixel in the heart, or let us pick a random one for you.

step2.title: Donate 1,000 RSD
step2.text: Continue to a secure payment page and pay by card.

step3.title: Reveal the artwork
step3.text: Your pixel takes the color of the final image, and you can share it as an Instagram story.

HowItWorks.note: Card payments are processed by RaiAccept / Raiffeisen Bank. We never store your card details.

Footer.disclaimer: This is a demo concept for a charity platform. All names, amounts and donors are illustrative. Real payments and personal data storage are not enabled.
